Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: A high-throughput molecular dynamics study with a machine-learning method on predicting diffusion coefficient of hydrogen in α-iron grain boundaries

Nominal_Composition.Note: Pure iron lattice used for hydrogen diffusion simulation

Process_Text.original: A total of 20,000 grain boundary configurations were generated using Monte-Carlo sampling from the SO(3) group, followed by MD simulations to calculate H diffusion coefficients.
Process_Text.simplified: 采用SO(3)群蒙特卡洛采样生成2万种晶界配置，通过分子动力学模拟计算氢扩散系数。

Microstructure_Text.original: Grain boundaries (GBs) with diverse orientations generated via random SO(3) rotations.
Microstructure_Text.simplified: 通过随机SO(3)旋转生成的具有多种取向的晶界。

Microstructure_Info.Note: Focuses on intergranular regions vs bulk.

Properties_Info.Note: The diffusion coefficient in GBs shows a significant decrease (up to 99%) compared to bulk BCC iron.
Reference value for bulk diffusion used as a baseline.
